"''Whatever they wanted.|Hunter and Stak|}} '''Setron''' was a [[jungle]] [[planet]] in the [[Expansion Region]]. [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] once had a [[Imperial medical laboratory|laboratory]] stationed on the planet. ==Description== Setron{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/paths-unknown-episode-guide|text="Paths Unknown" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} was a [[jungle]] [[planet]] dominated by large trees. It was located in the [[Setron system]] in the [[Noori sector]] of the [[Expansion Region]]. Shrouded in mist, the terrain was uneven and included ridges and hills. Setron appeared [[Color|green]] from [[realspace]] and had a rancid smell, which [[Wrecker]] described as comparable to the smell of a [[jotaz]]. ==History== [[File:ImpMedLabSetron-PathsUnknown.png|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial medical laboratory]] Early in the lifespan of the [[Galactic Empire]], a [[Imperial medical laboratory|medical laboratory]] was stationed on Setron and was operated by [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]. There, [[clone trooper]]s were held as [[prisoner]]s and had [[blood]] samples taken from them for testing. The Empire also created an experimental biological weapon known as [[slither vine]]s, but eventually lost control of the weapon, causing the [[jungle]]s of Setron to become overrun by the vines. A [[Base Delta Zero]] [[orbital bombardment]] was ordered to destroy the facility, and the Empire relocated their equipment and personnel to another world. Sometime later, [[Hunter]] and Wrecker of [[Clone Force 99]] arrived on Setron in their ship, the ''[[Marauder (Omicron-class)|Marauder]]'', hoping to find their captured sister [[Omega]]. Instead, they discovered three young [[clone cadet]]s, [[Deke]], [[Stak (cadet)|Stak]], and [[Mox]], who had survived the destruction of Hemlock's lab. The group worked together to navigate the ruins of the lab, retrieve information from the lab's database, and ultimately escape the infested planet. {{Planet-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Setron first appeared "[[Paths Unknown]]," the second episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. The planet's name was not mentioned in the episode, but was later revealed in the official episode guide on [[StarWars.com]]. ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Paths Unknown}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-paths-unknown|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Paths Unknown"}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/paths-unknown-episode-guide|text="Paths Unknown" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{1stID|Setron}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} *{{Databank|deke|Deke}} *{{Databank|mox|Mox}} *{{Databank|setron|Setron}} *{{Databank|slither-vines|slither vines}} *{{Databank|stak|Stak}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Setron |fr=Setron |ja=セトロン |ka=სეტრონი }} [[Category:Galactic Empire planets]] [[Category:Jungle planets]] [[Category:Noori sector locations]] [[Category:Planets in the Expansion Region]] [[Category:Planets in the Slice]]
